GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 10th 8 Lengths 800m 11th 8 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 10th widest runner Straight ran on final 100m # back/ok late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 57kg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (nose roll off) Jumped Well , Drifted Back Settled Down Inside 10th. 7 Lengths @ 700m. Same Position Straightening Up Hooked Out Wide all Clear . Made Good Ground late and grabbed 3rd on post # ran on well late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that his mount hung in noticeably and proved difficult to fully test. He said that near the 200m he attempted to shift to the outside, however, his mount was reluctant to do so and became awkwardly placed on heels. He added that shortly thereafter he was able to establish clear running to the outside where mount closed off strongly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer advised the gelding would now be spelled. Nevertheless, was advised a warning would be placed on the gelding’s record after being uncompetitive, beaten 19.5 L.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled back 10+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat

Debut for stable. Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 2nd on inside (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd on inside midrace & held together Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in Two Wide @ 250m. Boxed on until faded in last 100m. Vetted clear. # On-pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that his mnt travelled well through the early and middle stages, however, the gelding was inclined to lay in under pressure in the straight and didn’t finish off as well as expected. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Not Bustled Caught Four Wide early Restrained Settled Down 5th 1x1 Outside 1st 4 Lengths out 3 Wide 4th x 400m, Hard Ridden had its chance (gelded, t/t/1st) # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was contacted.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jmped ok, did little to be 4th, 4l. Became unbalanced near 450m. Turned for home 5l off with room. Didn't improve, finishing off greenly to line. # Didn't threaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with another runner. Passing the 800m, after being crossed, commenced to overrace and made the turn near the 700m awkwardly. When racing ungenerously near the 600m got its head up, shifted in and after being corrected then shifted out abruptly. Rdr reported the colt raced greenly throughout the event and proved difficult to ride. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
